top_violation_types.title: Infants sleep in Designated Crib, Cot, Bed, or Mat (26 TAC §746.2424)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was an infant asleep on a boppy pillow on the floor in the infant room. This was corrected during the inspection when the infant was moved to a crib.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two Epi Pens were located in the child's backpack. One backpack was in the hall accessible to children. One backpack was hanging on a hook in a classroom accessible to children.  This was corrected at inspection when the Epi-Pens were removed from the backpacks and placed in a cabinet where is was inaccessible to children.

top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - Infant Birth to 12 Months (26 TAC §746.2206(1)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver stated that infants are not engaged in outdoor play for a duration that each infant can tolerate.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were mixed with children greater than 18 months older than they are.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon arrival a 2 yr old was observed watching videos on Youtube
